bibl.title: Un accenno a Roma? Nota callimachea.
bibl.seg: Lorenzo Braccesi, Un accenno a Roma? Nota callimachea.
bibl.note: Focuses on a Callimachean passage [Hymn. Del. 166-170] and suggests that it may contain an allusion to Rome as a Western power over which Ptolemy I Soter could extend his protection.
